name: My Sweet College Daydreams
source:
Join Akira, a young man who just entered college. He hopes to master biology and many other valuable subjects. Instead, he will explore his supernatural abilities, which allow him to enjoy lucid dreams and the company of beautiful girls whenever he wants, as it seems. What could possibly go wrong here? Maybe someone is going to die? Yes, for sure, unless Akira can change the ill fate.

[From [url=https://wandering-peak.itch.io/college-daydreams]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入Akira，一个刚进入大学的年轻人。他希望掌握生物学和许多其他有价值的学科。相反，他会探索自己的超自然能力，这让他可以随时享受清醒梦和美丽女孩的陪伴，就像看起来的那样。这里可能会出现什么问题？也许有人会死？是的，当然，除非阿基拉能够改变厄运。

[来自[url=https://wandering-peak.itch.io/college-daydreams]itch.io[/url]]
